sentences.text:
Heard S/Sri Bharat Singh and Jitendra Kumar Yadav, learned counsel for both applicants and Sri D.P.S. Chauhan, learned A.G.A.
2.

These are second bail applications of applicants in Case Crime No. 438 of 2020 under Sections 363, 366, 120-B, 176, 372, 373, 376(A) and (B) I.P.C., Section 5/6 of POCSO Act and Section 5 of Immoral Trafficking Act, Police Station- Nigohi, District- Shahjahanpur.

Both applicants are in jail since 14.10.2022 and 16.10.2022 respectively.
3.

Learned counsel for applicants submit that on basis of nature of evidence of testimony of informant and victim (PW-1 and PW-2) and probability of conviction against applicants appears to be very remote.
4. At this stage, learned A.G.A. submits that this Court may take note of a status report submitted by trial Court.

5. I have perused the status report dated 28.03.2024 submitted by trial Court that by an order dated 14.03.2024, trial Court has recalled PW-1 and PW-2 for examination under Section 311 Cr.P.C.
6.

In these circumstances, at this stage, this Court cannot consider these bail applications since trial Court has recalled PW-1 and PW-2 for examination under Section 311 Cr.P.C.
7.

Therefore, Bail applications are rejected at this stage, however, applicants are at liberty to approach this Court again after statement of PW-1 and PW-2 is recorded under Section 311 Cr.P.C.
along with status of trial.
